headline: Fix: the new account and connector commands now respond when you say them.

items.prompt_template: A quick fix on top of the account controls that shipped in the last update: saying 'what accounts do I have', '[address] is my personal account', or 'set my email backend to [connector]' now reliably reaches the right handler. If you tried one of these and got a generic answer instead of the real thing, it works now.
